Hilchos Masa Umasan — Halachah 1

COMPLETE FULL TRANSLATION

Based on LM I:69

The root of nefashos is in wealth; masa umasan b'emunah; the prohibition of partnership with idolaters

Halachic  it shall not be heard upon [your mouth],' etc." (Shulchan Aruch, Orach Chaim 155).

Introduction
segments.he_nikud: אַחַר-כָּךְ יֵלֵךְ לַעֲסָקָיו וְכוּ' וְאָסוּר לְהִשְׁתַּתֵּף עִם עוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים שֶׁמָּא יִתְחַיֵּב לוֹ שְׁבוּעָה וְעוֹבֵר מִשּׁוּם וְשֵׁם אֱלֹקִים אֲחֵרִים לֹא תַזְכִּירוּ לֹא יִשָּׁמַע עַל וְכוּ'. (שֻׁלְחָן עָרוּךְ אֹרַח חַיִּים סִימָן קנה):

segments.he: הענין כי מבאר בדברי רבנו זכרונו לברכה (בסימן סט חלק א) ששרש הנפשות הוא בעשירות. ועקר הגדלת השם והנפש הוא על ידי עשירות דקדשה. כי עשירות דקדשה גבה מאד, עין שם:
segments.en:
The matter is as follows: It is explained in the words of Rabbainu zichrono livrachah (in Siman 69, Part I) that the root of the nefashos [souls] is in wealth. The essential magnification of the shem [name] and the nefesh [soul] is through holy wealth (ashirus d'kedushah), for holy wealth is exceedingly lofty — see there.

It emerges that holy money — which is Jewish money — is the aspect of shem [name] and nefesh [soul]. And the shem and nefesh of Israel is the aspect of the Name of Hashem, for His Name is joined with our name. This is the aspect of "Did you conduct your business dealings with emunah [faithfulness]?" — "b'emunah" specifically! For emunah is the aspect of the Name of Hashem — the aspect of "Hashem is One, and His Name is One" — which is the essence of emunah. Therefore one must conduct business with emunah, for the root of masa umasan [business] is embedded within emunah, which is the aspect of the Name of Hashem, since masa umasan and wealth are the aspect of shem as explained above.

And "G-d made this corresponding to that." For money of the Sitra Achra is the opposite: it is the aspect of the name of other gods, for all forms of idolatry are embedded in money, as Rabbainu zichrono livrachah states elsewhere (in Siman 23, Part I). The totality of Jewish money is the aspect of holy money, which is shem and nefesh, the aspect of the Name of Hashem as above. And the totality of idolaters' money is money of the Sitra Achra, which is the aspect of actual avodah zarah — the aspect of the name of other gods as above.

Now it is well explained why our Sages zichronam livrachah forbade entering into partnership with idolaters on account of "the name of other gods you shall not mention," etc. For certainly one violates "the name of other gods," etc., when one enters into partnership with idolaters, because the root of the nefashos is in wealth. When one enters into partnership with idolaters, one links one's own nefesh and the nefesh of the idolater together, chas v'shalom, so that both are rooted together in one pool of money — the very place where the root of the nefashos resides, as above. Therefore one certainly violates "the name of other gods," etc., for the nefesh and money of the idolater — which is the root of his nefesh — is the name of other gods. And "go, say to him" [= depart from it!] — it has no right to be joined with Jewish money, which is the aspect of the shem and nefesh of Israel, in which the Name of Hashem is embedded.

This is what our Sages zichronam livrachah said: "lest a [situation requiring an] oath arise." For a holy oath is the aspect of the Name of Hashem, as it is written: "You shall not take the Name of Hashem [in vain]," etc., and "you shall not swear by My Name [falsely]," etc. Therefore, wherever there is a dispute between two people and it is unknown to whom the money belongs, an oath is imposed between them. The oath clarifies the truth — to whom the money belongs. For the oath is the aspect of the Name of Hashem, which is the root of money (which is the aspect of shem, as above). Therefore through the oath, it becomes thoroughly clarified to whom the money belongs, since at its root, the money of each person is certainly well-clarified — no one can touch his fellow's [money] there at all.

Therefore our Sages zichronam livrachah were concerned lest the idolater be required to swear an oath. For this is something likely — close to certain. For idolaters are full of falsehood in business, because their money — which is money of the Sitra Achra — is taken from the aspect of sheker [falsehood], which is avodah zarah — the aspect of sheker. Therefore they are always suspected of falsehood, as it is written: "whose mouth speaks vanity and whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood." Therefore certainly the idolater will be required to swear their oath — which is the aspect of other gods, for from there is the root of their money, from the aspect of avodah zarah, from the aspect of the name of other gods, which is the aspect of their false oath. Therefore it is forbidden for a Jew to enter into partnership with him, for Jewish money is holy money — the root of his shem and nefesh, in which the Name of Hashem is embedded, as above.

See the discourse beginning "Whoever wishes to draw people close to Hashem," etc., where it is explained regarding the verse "I will give them in My house and within My walls a hand and a name [yad va'shem]" — there it explains well this principle that money is the aspect of shem and nefesh, as above.

segments.he_nikud: הָעִנְיָן כִּי מְבֹאָר בְּדִבְרֵי רַבֵּנוּ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה (בְּסִימָן סט חֵלֶק א) שֶׁשֹּׁרֶשׁ הַנְּפָשׁוֹת הוּא בָּעֲשִׁירוּת. וְעִקַּר הַגְדָּלַת הַשֵּׁם וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ הוּא עַל-יְדֵי עֲשִׁירוּת דִּקְדֻשָּׁה. כִּי עֲשִׁירוּת דִּקְדֻשָּׁה גָּבֹהַּ מְאֹד, עַיֵּן שָׁם:

segments.he: נמצא, שהממון דקדשה שהוא ממון ישראלי הוא בחינת שם ונפש. ושם ונפש ישראל הוא בחינת שם ה' כי שמו משתף בשמנו . וזה בחינת נשאת ונתת באמונה . 'באמונה' דיקא. כי אמונה הוא בחינת שם ה' , בחינת ה' אחד ושמו אחד שזה עקר אמונה, על כן צריך לעשות משא ומתן באמונה. כי שם שרש בחינת המשא ומתן בתוך בחינת אמונה שהוא בחינת שם ה'. כי המשא ומתן והעשירות הוא בחינת שם כנ"ל. ואת זה לעמת זה עשה האלקים . כי ממון דסטרא אחרא הוא בהפך, כי הוא בבחינת שם אלהים אחרים, כי כל עבודות זרות תחובים בממון, כמו שאמר רבנו זכרונו לברכה במקום אחר (בסימן כג ל"א). וכלל ממון ישראל הוא בחינת ממון דקדשה שהוא בחינת שם ונפש, בחינת שם ה' כנ"ל. וכלל ממון עובדי כוכבים הוא ממון דסטרא אחרא שהיא בחינת עבודה זרה ממש בחינת שם אלקים אחרים כנ"ל. ועתה מבאר היטב מה שאסרו רבותינו זכרונם לברכה להשתתף עם עובדי כוכבים משום ושם אלקים אחרים לא תזכירו וכו'. כי בודאי עובר על ושם אלקים אחרים וכו' כשמשתתף עם העובדי כוכבים. כי שרש הנפשות בעשירות. וכשמשתתף עם העובדי כוכבים. נמצא שמקשר נפשו ונפש העובדי כוכבים חס ושלום ביחד שיהיו שניהם משרשים ביחד בממון אחד אשר שם שרש הנפשות כנ"ל. ועל כן בודאי עובר על ושם אלקים אחרים וכו'. כי נפש וממון עובדי כוכבים שהוא שרש נפשו הוא שם אלקים אחרים. ו'צא תאמר לו' ואין לו להתחבר עם ממון ישראל שהוא בחינת שם ונפש ישראל אשר משתף בו שם ה':

Based on LM I:35

Business as rest for the mind; prohibition of mentioning Hashem's Name in vain

Halachic framework: "After leaving the synagogue he shall go to the bais midrash, etc., to study, etc." (Ibid. Siman 155). This has already been explained above: one must study after prayer in order to acquire life, etc. "And afterward he shall go to his business, for all Torah without work is destined to be nullified and brings sin. And he should be careful not to mention the Name of Heaven in vain, etc."

For one must conduct business after study, in order to give rest (nichas) to the mind so that it will not be overtaxed. As Rabbainu explains explicitly (in Siman 35): business is the aspect of sleep, which gives rest to the mind. For one must specifically give rest to the mind when it is fatigued, so that there will not be a situation of "excessive light causing the shattering of the vessels." For when one thinks excessively with one's intellect without giving it rest, the brain — which is the vessel of the intellect — cannot receive the abundant light of the intellect. Then the brain becomes completely ruined, and one can lose one's mind entirely.

This is the aspect of "all Torah without [work] is destined to be nullified [b'tailah]." For one comes to the aspect of bitul [nullification/cessation], because the vessels cannot receive the excessive occupation with Torah. The excessive light causes the shattering of the vessels. Then the intellect exits from the tzimtzum [contraction/boundary] and becomes completely nullified. Then the brain is ruined and collapses entirely — for the essential endurance of the mind depends on the vessels being able to receive the intellect and contract it within themselves.

This is [the meaning of] "destined to be nullified and brings [goreres] sin." For when the intellect departs into bitul due to the shattering of the vessels caused by excessive light, from this the kelippos are formed — as is brought [in the writings of the Arizal]. This is "and brings sin." And this is observable in reality: when the brain is overtaxed excessively and one gives it no rest at all, it can become clouded and completely ruined. And through the confusion of da'as [awareness], one can, chas v'shalom, be drawn into sin.
segments.he_nikud: נִמְצָא, שֶׁהַמָּמוֹן דִּקְדֻשָּׁה שֶׁהוּא מָמוֹן יִשְׂרְאֵלִי הוּא בְּחִינַת שֵׁם וְנֶפֶשׁ. וְשֵׁם וְנֶפֶשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא בְּחִינַת שֵׁם ה' כִּי שְׁמוֹ מְשֻׁתָּף בִּשְׁמֵנוּ. וְזֶה בְּחִינַת נָשָׂאתָ וְנָתַתָּ בֶּאֱמוּנָה. 'בֶּאֱמוּנָה' דַּיְקָא. כִּי אֱמוּנָה הִוא בְּחִינַת שֵׁם ה', בְּחִינַת ה' אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד שֶׁזֶּה עִקַּר אֱמוּנָה, עַל-כֵּן צָרִיךְ לַעֲשׂוֹת מַשָּא וּמַתָּן בֶּאֱמוּנָה. כִּי שָׁם שֹׁרֶשׁ בְּחִינַת הַמַּשָּא וּמַתָּן בְּתוֹךְ בְּחִינַת אֱמוּנָה שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת שֵׁם ה'. כִּי הַמַּשָּא וּמַתָּן וְהָעֲשִׁירוּת הוּא בְּחִינַת שֵׁם כַּנַּ"ל. וְאֶת זֶה לְעֻמַּת זֶה עָשָׂה הָאֱלֹקִים. כִּי מָמוֹן דְּסִטְרָא אָחֳרָא הוּא בְּהֵפֶךְ, כִּי הוּא בִּבְחִינַת שֵׁם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים, כִּי כָּל עֲבוֹדוֹת זָרוֹת תְּחוּבִים בַּמָּמוֹן, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמַר רַבֵּנוּ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר (בְּסִימָן כג ל"א). וּכְלַל מָמוֹן יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא בְּחִינַת מָמוֹן דִּקְדֻשָּׁה שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת שֵׁם וְנֶפֶשׁ, בְּחִינַת שֵׁם ה' כַּנַּ"ל. וּכְלַל מָמוֹן עוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים הוּא מָמוֹן דְּסִטְרָא אָחֳרָא שֶׁהִיא בְּחִינַת עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה מַמָּשׁ בְּחִינַת שֵׁם אֱלֹקִים אֲחֵרִים כַּנַּ"ל. וְעַתָּה מְבֹאָר הֵיטֵב מַה שֶּׁאָסְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה לְהִשְׁתַּתֵּף עִם עוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים מִשּׁוּם וְשֵׁם אֱלֹקִים אֲחֵרִים לֹא תַזְכִּירוּ וְכוּ'. כִּי בְּוַדַּאי עוֹבֵר עַל וְשֵׁם אֱלֹקִים אֲחֵרִים וְכוּ' כְּשֶׁמִּשְׁתַּתֵּף עִם הָעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים. כִּי שֹׁרֶשׁ הַנְּפָשׁוֹת בַּעֲשִׁירוּת. וּכְשֶׁמִּשְׁתַּתֵּף עִם הָעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים. נִמְצָא שֶׁמְּקַשֵּׁר נַפְשׁוֹ וְנֶפֶשׁ הָעוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים חַס וְשָׁלוֹם בְּיַחַד שֶׁיִּהְיוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם מֻשְׁרָשִׁים בְּיַחַד בְּמָמוֹן אֶחָד אֲשֶׁר שָׁם שֹׁרֶשׁ הַנְּפָשׁוֹת כַּנַּ"ל. וְעַל-כֵּן בְּוַדַּאי עוֹבֵר עַל וְשֵׁם אֱלֹקִים אֲחֵרִים וְכוּ'. כִּי נֶפֶשׁ וּמָמוֹן עוֹבְדֵי כּוֹכָבִים שֶׁהוּא שֹׁרֶשׁ נַפְשׁוֹ הוּא שֵׁם אֱלֹקִים אֲחֵרִים. וְ'צֵא תֹּאמַר לוֹ' וְאֵין לוֹ לְהִתְחַבֵּר עִם מָמוֹן יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת שֵׁם וְנֶפֶשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר מְשֻׁתָּף בּוֹ שֵׁם ה':

segments.he: וזה שאמרו רבותינו זכרונם לברכה: שמא יתחיב לו שבועה. כי שבועה דקדשה הוא בחינת שם ה'. כמו שכתוב: לא תשא את שם ה' וכו' ולא תשבעו בשמי וכו'. ועל כן בכל מקום שיש הכחשה בין שני אנשים ואין יודעים למי מגיע הממון, אז מטילים ביניהם שבועה. והשבועה מבררת האמת למי מגיע הממון. כי השבועה היא בחינת שם ה', שהוא בחינת שרש הממון, שהוא בחינת שם כנ"ל, על כן על ידי השבועה מתברר היטב למי שיך הממון מאחר שהוא שרש הממון. כי שם בשרשו בודאי מברר היטב ממונו של כל אחד ואחד, ואין אחד יכול לגע שם בשל חברו כלום. ועל כן חששו רבותינו זכרונם לברכה שמא יתחיב לו העובד כוכבים שבועה. כי הוא מלתא דשכיחא וקרוב לודאי. כי עובדי כוכבים הם מלאים שקר במשא ומתן, כי ממונם, שהוא ממון דסטרא אחרא, נלקח משם מבחינת שקר שהוא עבודה זרה שהוא בחינת שקר, ועל כן הם חשודים תמיד על שקר, כמו שכתוב: אשר פיהם דבר שוא וימינם ימין שקר. ועל כן בודאי יתחיב לו העובד כוכבים שבועה שלהם שהוא בחינת אלקים אחרים, כי משם שרש ממונם מבחינת עבודה זרה מבחינת שם אלקים אחרים שהוא בחינת שבועת שקר שלהם ועל כן אסור לישראל להשתתף עמו, כי ממון ישראל הוא ממון דקדשה שהוא בחינת שרש שמו ונפשו אשר משתף בו שם ה' כנ"ל:
segments.en:
This is why our Sages zichronam livrachah warned about business — that one should be careful not to mention the Name of Heaven in vain, as written in the Shulchan Aruch, placing this prohibition adjacent to [the laws of] business. For the prohibition of mentioning the Name of Heaven in vain is also of this same nature. When one mentions the Name of Heaven, one is, as it were, calling upon Him, kivyachol — the Life of all lives — as is explained there [in the Torah of Rabbainu]. Therefore one must not mention the Name of Heaven except in Torah and prayer, for there the vessels and middos [measures] exist to receive the life-force.

And even though the Name itself is the aspect of middos, as is explained there — nonetheless, it is known that there are vessels for vessels and contraction within contraction. What is considered a vessel at a higher level is still, at a lower level, the aspect of simple light without a vessel, and another contraction and vessel must be fashioned to receive it. Therefore it is forbidden to mention the Name of Heaven by itself, except in Torah and prayer, where the other words become vessels to receive the light, as above. But when one mentions the Name of Heaven in vain — without Torah and prayer — it is the aspect of "excessive oil causing the lamp to go out." Therefore mentioning the Name of Heaven in vain is graver than a berachah in vain, as above.

This is the aspect of "Name of Heaven in vain [l'vatalah]" — the aspect of "destined to be nullified [b'tailah]" as above — for it causes the bitul mentioned above, i.e. the ruination of the vessels, as above. Therefore our Sages zichronam livrachah said: "wherever mention of the Name of Heaven is common, death is common," for it is the opposite of calling forth life and length of days mentioned above. For that is achieved specifically through the middos and vessels that are made through Torah study, as above. And mentioning the Name of Heaven in vain is the opposite of this, as above. Therefore, at the time of business — which exists to preserve the vessels so they will not be ruined, as above — one must be careful then about mentioning the Name of Heaven in vain, which is a blemish and ruination of the vessels, as above.

✦ ✦ ✦

Brief Summary Appearing at End of Halachah 2 in the Text

[The text presents a brief outline of key topics from Netilas Yadayim and Betzias HaPas, Halachah 2:]

The essential power of the Sitra Achra is in the place where there is holiness. This is [the concept of] chametz and matzah. Netilas yadayim [washing hands] = raising them in the aspect of "let us lift our hearts [with our hands]" — in order to receive for them from Heaven. Therefore one must think thoughts of teshuvah before eating = the aspect of a sigh.

"And you shall not go in haste" — in the final section [of the Torah], because there is the receiving of the Torah; but then [in Mitzrayim] they went in haste, for Pharaoh's authority was still upon them — therefore they ate matzah, as it is written: "they baked the dough," etc. One must learn [Torah] at the table = the aspect of Torah study. Eating is the aspect of learning, as it is written: "come, buy and eat." As if they ate from the sacrifices of the dead = the opposite of life. The table is the table of kings — "fortunate is your land whose king is a free man, and whose princes eat at the proper time."

segments.he: ועין במאמר המתחיל מי שרוצה לקרב בני אדם להשם יתברך וכו' מה שמבאר שם על פסוק: ונתתי להם בביתי ובחומתי יד ושם כנ"ל שם מבאר היטב הקדמה זו שהממון הוא בחינת שם ונפש כנ"ל:
segments.en:
The washing with water = the aspect of chesed = the aspect of a mikveh of water. A revi'is [quarter-log] = the aspect of Malchus, the aspect of Dalet becoming Hai — da'as, the aspect of revi'is ha'hin. A vessel and the strength of a man [are required] — even when one does not eat with his hands, one must wash; conversely, one who feeds [another] need not [wash]. Ten words in Birchas HaMotzi, and one must also hold [the bread] with all ten fingers — corresponding to Malchus [and] the ministers of tens. The greatest of those reclining is the one who breaks bread. Through eating in a kasher manner, da'as is completed.

Masa Umasan, Halachah 3: its whereabouts is not known to us.

✦ Translator's Summary — Halachos 1–2 ✦

Halachah 1 (LM I:69): The root of nefashos is in wealth. Jewish money = shem and nefesh = the Name of Hashem. Idolaters' money = the name of other gods = avodah zarah. Partnership mixes these roots. Oaths = the Name of Hashem = clarify money's true ownership. Since idolaters are rooted in sheker, their oaths = name of other gods. Therefore partnership is forbidden.

Halachah 2 (LM I:35): Business gives rest to the mind after Torah study, preventing "excessive light shattering the vessels." "Torah without work is destined to be nullified and brings sin." Mentioning the Name of Heaven in vain ruins the vessels — worse than a berachah in vain: "excessive oil extinguishes the lamp." "Wherever mention of the Name is common, death is common." During business (which preserves vessels), one must be especially careful about mentioning the Name in vain.

The end of Halachah 2 includes a brief outline of key concepts from Netilas Yadayim/Betzias HaPas Halachah 2. Halachah 3: "its whereabouts is not known to us."
